chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yaqoub al-Sarraaj who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'When will there be relief for your Shites?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When the children of Al-Abbas differ, and their authority weakens, and he who was not greedy for it before covets it, and the Arabs remove their reins, and every horseman raises his spur, and the Syrian appears, and the Yemenite comes forward, and the Hasany moves, and the Master of this Command comes out from Medina to Mecca with the inheritance of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).'

So I said, 'What is the inheritance of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The sword of the Messenger of Allah, and his armor, and his turban, and his gown, and his staff, and his banner, and his helmet, and his saddle, until he descends to Mecca.'

He will take out the sword from its sheath, and put on the armor, and display the banner, and (wear) the gown and the turban, and grab the staff by his hand, and seek Permission of Allah for his appearance.
That will be announced to some of his friends. The Hasany would come. So he would inform him of the news. The Hasany would initiate the coming out.
The people of Mecca would pounce upon him. So they will kill him and send his head to the Syrian.
During that, the Master of this Command will appear. So the people would pledge their allegiances to him and follow him.
And the Syrian would send an army to Medina. So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, would destroy them before it (gets there).
On that day, those from the children of Ali (peace be upon him) who would be in Medina would flee to Mecca. So they would join up with the Master of this Command.
And the Master of this Command would go towards Iraq and send his army to Medina. Its people would express belief and they would return to it.

key_terms.تُرَاثُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Inheritance of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the relief of the Shites according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi outlines the complex eschatological timeline of the Mahdi's emergence, emphasizing the transitional chaos involving the Syrian, Yemenite, and Hasany figures before the Master of the Command (Sahib al-Amr) reveals the Prophet's physical inheritance—such as his sword and armor—to legitimize his rule. Shia scholars interpret the 'Prophet's inheritance' not merely as material wealth but as the symbols of authority and spiritual legacy that validate the Mahdi's political and religious leadership during the final phase of history.

en.hubeali: H 14733 – And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Yaqoub Al-Sarraaj who said:

I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘When will there be relief for yourasws Shites?’ Heasws said: ‘When the children of Al-Abbas differ regarding their authority, and he who was not greedy for it before, covets it, and the Arabs remove their reins, and every one with spurs (horsemen) battles for it, and Al-Shamy (The Syrian) appears, and Al-Yamany (The Yemenite) comes forward, and Al-Hasany moves (with a movement), and the Masterasws of this Command will come out from Al-Medina to Al-Makkah with the inheritance of the Rasool Allahsaww’.

So I said, ‘What inheritance of the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Sword of the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and his<sup>saww</sup> armor, and his<sup>saww</sup> turban, and his<sup>saww</sup> gown, and his<sup>saww</sup> staff, and his<sup>saww</sup> banner, and his<sup>saww</sup> helmet, and his<sup>saww</sup> saddle, until he<sup>asws</sup> descends upon Makkah.

So he<sup>asws</sup> will take out the sword from its sheath, and put on the armor, and display the banner, and (wear) the gown and the turban, and grab the staff by his<sup>asws</sup> hand, and seek Permission of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for his<sup>asws</sup> appearance.
That will be announced to some of his<sup>asws</sup> friends. Al-Hassany would come. So he<sup>asws</sup> would inform him of the news. Al-Hassany would initiate the coming out (Al-Khurouj).
The people of Makkah would pounce upon him. So they will kill him and send his head to Al-Shamy (The Syrian).
During that, the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this Command will appear. So the people would pledge their allegiances to him<sup>asws</sup> and follow him<sup>asws</sup>.
And Al-Shamy (The Syrian) would send an army to Al-Medina. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Destroy them before it (gets there).
On that day, those from the children of Ali<sup>asws</sup> who would be in Al-Medina would flee to Makkah. So they would join up with the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this Command.
And the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this Command would go towards Al-Iraq and send his<sup>asws</sup> army to Al-Medina. Its people would express belief and they would return to it’.
